visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white coat walks across a green crosswalk towards the entrance of National Chengchi University, framed by lush trees and traditional university architecture. (2) Close-up shots show a large banyan tree with exposed roots and an official sign for the Alumni Association; groups of people gather outside a building where a red banner is visible. (3) The scene moves indoors to an alumni lounge decorated with fresh flowers, fruit platters, and bottles of sparkling cider on long tables. (4) Multiple alumni sit around tables in a brightly lit indoor space, engaging in animated conversation, eating snacks, and laughing while a camera on a tripod stands nearby. (5) A series of group photos follow, showing women posing playfully and a large group of men and women holding a long red banner outdoors. (6) The group is seen organizing themselves on a street corner for a large group photo, stretching the red banner across the frame. (7) Final scenes show people clinking paper cups and glasses indoors, smiling and celebrating their reunion.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 30年前我們一起在政大念書. (2) [Slogan]: 金融青春會 千歲. (3) [Logo]: 國立政治大學. (4) [Subtitle]: 今天我們聚在一起 快要湊到一千歲了. (5) [Subtitle]: 雖然不是每個人都能來 但每個願意來的人 都讓今天變得很特別. (6) [Subtitle]: 辛苦的主辦人 幾個月前就開始張羅 今天還提早來這裡佈置 真的超感動的. (7) [Subtitle]: 同學會最讓人開心的 不只是見到彼此 還能想起那些女生們 以前一起嘰嘰喳喳的時光 還有男生們在旁邊練肖威. (8) [Variety]: ☺. (9) [Subtitle]: 我們從彼此的身上 看到年輕時候的我們 彷彿又回到了大學時光. (10) [Subtitle]: 年輕的時候 常常熬夜又吃冰 以為中年還很遙遠. (11) [Subtitle]: 結果今天一坐下來 每個人都是喝熱咖啡 或是喝溫開水. (12) [Subtitle]: 還要拉著紅布條拍照 拍完又再拍. (13) [Subtitle]: 歲月會帶走年輕 卻帶不走我們 曾經一起在宿舍打鬧 一起騎機車出去玩 還有一起熬過考試的回憶. (14) [Subtitle]: 謝謝今天來的每一位同學 謝謝還記得這段青春的你 謝謝.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, melodic acoustic guitar track. A warm, sentimental female narrator begins her voiceover with clear articulation and moderate speed. (2) Faint background chatter of an outdoor environment is present, mixed with the guitar BGM. (3) As the video transitions indoors, the acoustic guitar continues, now accompanied by the sounds of multiple voices laughing and greeting one another with moderate arousal. (4) The narrator’s tone becomes reflective, with consistent pacing. Incidental sounds of paper rustling and light ceramic clinking are audible under the speech. (5) A sharp percussive 'click' occurs, mimicking a camera shutter sound. The music maintains a nostalgic major mode. (6) The final phase features high vocal energy from a group of people cheering together, followed by the distinct sound of glass clinking. The narrator concludes with a soft, grateful 'Thank you' as the music gently fades.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a heartwarming commemorative vlog documenting a 30-year college class reunion for Finance alumni at National Chengchi University. By blending nostalgic voiceover reflections with modern-day footage of friends reconnecting, laughing, and recreating photos, the video emphasizes the enduring nature of friendship despite the passage of time.
